# Vendored Si468x core

`Si468x.h` is copied without modification from
https://github.com/bales0/Si468x_library at commit
`b671d372a4fe5bb4df493ea6147c215577b25dc2`.

The SHA-256 of the synchronized header is
`A894CF940CBD143D9C0917BF68C3F335370AF28FC06E9D074F0EEA91545FBF6E`.

Application scheduling, EEPROM, UI, RDS content decoding and MOT assembly stay
outside the protocol-only vendored core.
